g.text: 1. Cold preheat train E-101..E-105 crude shell-side except E-105 (crude tube-side).
2. Desalter mix valves PDV-1005/1006 set at 0.5-1.5 bar dP; 2-stage counter-current wash.
3. Chemical packages X-101 (demulsifier) and X-102 (caustic) ratio-controlled to FIC-1001.
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
